title: EM9305 name the 12 e1 typo-RAM pointer literals, reserve 0x8012ba-0x8012bb, typo-install proved users, and p-e1typo paired sims
reason: Name the 12 untyped typo-RAM literals in ini_record e1 where code users prove a field; reserve the boot-written 8012ba hole in g2-em9305.ld without overlapping g2_em_qf_next_priority at 8012bc; typo residual/ProtTimer/System_SaveRestore/controller_init shims that those fields enable; one private pbuild plus paired sims.

grown_in_place: em9305_ram_80fd2c through u32_80fd80 (hook records at 80fd60/80fd74 and System_Save pointer)

users.0x80fb64: sleep_lock_update table index 5; IRQ_Init record base (EM_CONFIG_PTR). Fields u32_80fb64/68/6c plus level u8_80fb78 and priority-table u32_80fb7c.
users.0x80fb80: sleep_lock_update table index 0; grew 80fb48. u32_80fb80 (PML_Init hook) and companions 80fb84/80fb88. The PML_Init comment that called 0x80fb80 the parameter record is stale: the parameter record is em9305_ram_80fb8c (already typo'd).
users.0x80fd20: sleep_lock_update table index 3 and ProtTimer hook record (pal_metadata_reset / Store / Restore). New 12-byte object; not merged into 80fd2c so existing field offsets stay put. ProtTimer typo uses u32_80fd2c and u8_80fd34 and does not index the 12-byte object past its end.
users.0x80fd60: sleep_lock_update table index 4; field u32_80fd60 on grown 80fd2c.
users.0x80fd74: sleep_lock_update table index 1; field u32_80fd74. App treats 80fd74 and 80ff54 as two distinct hook objects, not a ROM range. The ld ROM-range claim stays UNVERIFIED (ROM is not in the repo).
users.0x80ff54: sleep_lock_update table index 2 in RAMHI. p-arctimer-ini and p-e1typo RAMHI .sdata/.data/.bss are empty (__bss_end=0x80fe20). ld ASSERT(__bss_end <= 0x80ff54). Object is 8 bytes only; 0x80ffa8 (boot-written table entry) is not merged.
users.0x80110c: IRQ_Store/Restore save area. After e1, u32_80fb70 points here. 188-byte gap to 8011c8 (17+17 words, 50 priority bytes, status, 1 pad).
users.0x8011c8: PML context. After e1, em9305_ram_80fb8c holds this address. 48-byte gap to 8011f8; +38 written by controller_timer_helpers.
users.0x8011f8: ProtTimer saved-configuration block and sleep_sync context. After e1, u32_80fd2c points here. 80-byte gap to 801248.
users.0x801248: RF config bytes written through u32_80fd44 / EM_RF_CFG_PTR. 8-byte gap to 801250.
users.0x801250: System_Save/Restore record. After e1, u32_80fd80 points here. Offsets through 0x4c; 80-byte gap to 8012a0.
users.0x8012a0: timer context via u32_80fde0. Word 0 and bytes +4, +5+bit, +11, +13, +14; 24-byte gap to 8012b8.

hole_8012ba.user_request: Reserve 0x8012ba-0x8012bf so nothing is placed there later (e0 writes it at boot).
hole_8012ba.layout: em9305_ram_8012b8 is 2 bytes at 0x8012b8-0x8012b9. 0x8012ba-0x8012bb was an unreserved 2-byte gap. 0x8012bc-0x8012bf is already the 4-byte .bss.stock_8012bc pin for g2_em_qf_next_priority. Growing 8012b8 to 8 bytes would overlap that pin, so it was not grown.
hole_8012ba.ld: Added .bss.stock_8012ba 0x008012ba (NOLOAD) { . += 2; } and ASSERTs: size 2, adjacent to 8012bc, 8012bc+4==8012c0. p-e1typo map shows the 2-byte section at 0x8012ba and all three ASSERTs true.
hole_8012ba.e0: Retyped hole_8012ba[6] as pad_8012ba[2]={0,0} plus qf_next_priority=0x00000010u (value, not a reloc to the RAM cell). Unlinked and linked bytes at 8012ba-8012bf remain 00 00 10 00 00 00.
hole_8012ba.link_closure_comment: Updated: e0 now writes 0x10 into 0x8012bc at boot.

typo_proofs.compared_to: pre-typo C kept only in the workspace (not a tree revert); mutants vs that stock, not typo-vs-typo
notes: ProtTimer typo vs stock EQUIVALENT 100 both symbols. Mutant u32_80fd2c->u32_80fd44 KILLED stock_310c08 (memhash:67); stock_310aa8 survived (classes=1, weak observation) but uses the same field.
System_SaveRestore typo vs stock EQUIVALENT 100 both symbols. Mutant u32_80fd80->u32_80fd74 KILLED both (memhash:64 and callhash:58).
IRQ_Init/Store/Restore typo vs stock EQUIVALENT 100. Mutant u32_80fb70->u32_80fb64 KILLED stock_3069c4 (memhash:68); stock_306968 survived (classes=1, restore path poorly observed).

stock_306924 typo vs stock EQUIVALENT 100, but the u32_80fb7c/u8_80fb78 mutant SURVIVED (EQUIVALENT 100). AUX_IRQ_PRIORITY and seti are likely unobserved in the harness. The typo is address-identical to the previous EM_CONFIG_PTR+offset form; left installed with this observation gap noted. Not treated as a vacuous typo-vs-typo run.
RF_CFG / SPIM typo vs stock EQUIVALENT 100 both symbols. Mutant u32_80fd44/u8_80fd38 KILLED both (memhash:66 and memhash:100).
controller_init radio_apply_3120a0 typo of &80fd2c+0xc to &u8_80fd38 is the same address; not separately QEMU-proved (huge TU).

ini_record_byte_compare.detail: Compiled with the unit pbuild flags. The only differences versus the p-arctimer-ini object are the 12 typo-RAM pointer words, which became R_ARC_32 sites (unlinked value 0) at record offsets 0x5c,0x60,0x64,0x68,0x6c,0x70,0xe0,0xfc,0x29c,0x2b4,0x2f0,0x350. All other record and section bytes match, including e0's 00 00 10 00 00 00 at 8012ba-8012bf. After link those 12 resolve to the same addresses as the previous literals.
ini_record_byte_compare.linked: Not bit-identical to p-arctimer-ini: .text shrank 64 bytes (239216 -> 239152) because typo'd C in ProtTimer, residual_code, System_SaveRestore, and controller_init changed codegen. Application end is now 0x0033CA30. The record VMA moved with it (0x0033c65c). Relocated code pointers in the record therefore differ; typo-RAM addresses stay the same.

package.note: Record-2 and application CRCs changed because the app is 64 bytes shorter. Bootloader CRC is unchanged from p-arctimer-ini/p-irqtypo (0x1D6121C4).

sims.renode: g2-firmware-emulator scripts/run-renode.sh, Renode 1.17.0, 8 s virtual runs, 1200 s wall cap
